{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gingerbell Blossom Festival''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] festival dedicated to the [[gingerbell]] plant.<ref name="hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

When she was young, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was forbidden by her father, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], to attend that year's festival when she was caught secretly watching a party held in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace's]] [[Grand Ballroom (Aldera Royal Palace)|Grand Ballroom]]; a party she was not able to attend as punishment for putting a [[Alderaan furry moth|wooly moth]] inside the [[Unidentified Minister of Agriculture (Alderaan)|Minister of Agriculture's]] desk drawer.<ref name="hostage" />
